description: Accessible Parking Spaces SDCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by South Dublin County Council. This dataset outlines the public accessible parking bays on roads and streets within the South Dublin County Council Administrative Area. Fields include index, geographical co-ordinates, street name and the number of spaces at that location. Coverage: South Dublin County Council. The portal files it under the publisher South Dublin County Council. Its tags are Accessible, Open data, Parking, SDCC, South Dublin. It offers 6 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
